cases.name: Chantill Madet Harrison

cases.name: Nilufa "Yasmin" Easmin
cases.about: She was an immigrant from Bangladesh and a clerk at the D & D Convenience Store gas station. Her Go Fund Me said: "Easmin was a devoted mother who worked tirelessly to provide for her two young daughters."
cases.narrative: Videos show Rolbert Joachin hitting a car multiple times in front of the D & D Convenience Store, when Nilufa Easmin leaves the store, standing in front of it. He rushes toward her, skips once, and, raising the hammer, strikes her in the head. She immediately collapses while he continues beating her. He then leaves on foot.
